verdicts.quote: “The MrScraper API uses API token authentication… Include your API token in the request header: x-api-token”
verdicts.reason: The docs show header-based “x-api-token” auth and the API reference labels the scheme as apiKey, which fits the “API key” enum better than “Bearer/PAT token.” ([docs.mrscraper.com](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/api/authentication?utm_source=openai))

verdicts.quote: “Scraper Free includes 1,000 MrScraper tokens every month at no cost - no credit card required.”
verdicts.reason: Pricing and docs indicate you can sign up free and obtain an API token yourself; no app review is required for basic use. Note: one docs page mentions “The Free plan includes 100 tokens per month,” but both confirm no-CC, self-serve credentials. ([mrscraper.com](https://mrscraper.com/pricing?utm_source=openai))

verdicts.quote: “API Reference… Scraper API… Web Fetching GET… Scrape Markdown POST… Get Screenshot POST… Scrape JSON POST… Platform… Authentication… Scraper… Result… Analytic”
verdicts.reason: The reference spans multiple functional areas (scraper runs/results, web fetching, markdown/screenshot/JSON, analytics). That’s more than a handful but not the entire product surface, matching “moderate.” ([docs.mrscraper.com](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/api/v3/result/all?utm_source=openai))

verdicts.quote: “Official MrScraper MCP server… Connect to the hosted MCP endpoint through Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1 browser sign-in.”
verdicts.reason: This is the vendor’s own MCP server and hosted endpoint, with OAuth 2.1 sign-in and a published open‑source package, so it’s “official.” ([docs.mrscraper.com](https://docs.mrscraper.com/docs/getting-started/mcp-server))

verdicts.quote: “How do I get my API Token? Sign in to the dashboard, open your account settings, and copy the token from the API Token page. Every API request authenticates with it…”
verdicts.reason: Self‑serve tokens plus clear REST docs and SDK/CLI mean Composio could ship today without special approval. Free plan limits exist but aren’t blockers. ([mrscraper.com](https://mrscraper.com/pricing?utm_source=openai))
